decisions.correction: Keep the same composition, lighting and setting: Nagoji and Ibrahim riding up the sandy path at left, Kayal a plain bay mare with black mane and black lower legs and no white markings, the guard at right craning up at the lookout palm, ships small on the horizon, open sky in the upper centre. Passes. Clean on every hard check: flush gold stud, clean-shaven chin, sleeves to the wrists, barefoot, talwar at the sash, no text (the map carries only dotted routes). Minor: the tokens on the map are scallop shells, not the cowrie used in 3.3.

Passes every hard check: white cloth band with no turban, bare chest, gold necklaces, cream mundu with gold border, spear laid aside, looking up, sound hands, no text, clear wall space for both balloons. All hard checks pass: Varma matches varma-v1 in the formal Tengapattanam look (cream-and-gold turban with jewelled peacock crest, bare chest, cream-and-gold cloth, gold necklaces), no white headband; Dutch trumpeters, drummer and musket ranks in blue coats as the script asks; no text (the flag is a plain red-white-blue tricolour), no blood, no European chairs. decisions.correction: Keep this composition: Nagoji in the rust-red turban, cream tunic and broad red sash, centred behind the king's red-cushioned seat in torch and lamp light, with Dhanaji (white pagdi, short black beard, indigo quilted tunic) on his right and two off-white-turbaned riders on each side, plus the plain unlettered red banner and the open night pavilion. His left hand grips only the scabbard of his talwar, with no extra thin rod, needle or second blade projecting from the hand. Show both hands clearly, with old healed scars across the knuckles and slightly ridged nails. Draw the lower-left foreground as the plain carved back of the king's seat, or the king from behind in cream-and-gold cloth and his cream-and-gold crested turban, never as a figure in red brocade.

No check fails. Van Imhoff (full white powdered wig, dark navy coat with gold braid, heavy-set) matches 5.4. He reads a little older than the thirties in the bible, but he looks the same in 5.4. decisions.correction: Keep Varma exactly as drawn: the cream-and-gold turban with jewelled peacock-feather crest, bare chest, gold necklaces, cream-and-gold cloth, the calm warm smile and the open left-hand gesture. Keep him at the same low wooden table with brass open-wick lamps, under the thatched beach pavilion at night with the moonlit sea behind. The figure seated across the table in the foreground, seen from behind or over the shoulder, must be Gustaaf Willem van Imhoff exactly as in the previous panel. That means a heavy-set man in a full white powdered wig with rolled curls at the sides and a black ribbon at the nape, and a dark navy coat with gold braid and frogging. Remove the second seated European at the right of the table; any Dutch soldiers in blue coats stand only small in the far background. Keep the dark night sky at upper right clear and low-detail for two speech balloons, with no text, letters, balloons or boxes painted in the art.

Minor only. The interpreter stands a step behind the lead envoy rather than at his elbow. The second envoy is also present, which the script does not ask for but which is harmless and consistent with 8.3. Varma gazes past the envoy, which fits his aloof line. Lettering note: the interpreter's head is right beside the envoy's face. The ENVOY balloon should therefore sit high left over the roof and blind band, with its tail coming down onto the envoy's grey hair, not across the interpreter. decisions.issues: v02 passes the checks, with minor notes only. Nagoji passes his checks: a faint smile under the thick curled moustache, a small flush gold stud with nothing hanging, sleeves down, arms crossed, leaning at his pillar with sash and talwar. FAIL ear check: Nagoji's earring has a gold ball hanging below the earlobe, outlined separately from the lobe. That is a drop, not a flush stud. decisions.correction: Nagoji's earring must be one tiny gold stud sitting flush on the face of his earlobe, with nothing hanging beneath the lobe: no bead, ball or drop below the ear. decisions.issues: Clean. Ibrahim matches his sheet: white turban, short grey-flecked beard, LEFT ear-to-jaw scar visible, teal short coat over the pocketed vest, white shoulder cloth and mundu. v02 passes all hard checks. The high view looks down from the ridge. Five Maravar riders splash knee-deep through the shallows, and farther inland a slow line of four Kerala bullock carts moves along the track. Minor: at this size the riders' heads read as dark round caps or close dark hair rather than turbans, and one rider is on a white horse. The panel has no lettering. v01 still fails: four-wheeled canvas covered wagons, an anachronism.

The ensign is a plain unlettered tricolour, and the stern carving is a plain shield with no letters or monogram. There is no text and no anachronism. decisions.correction: Keep this composition exactly: Ibrahim at left on his dark horse, Nagoji at right on Kayal, Nagoji's right hand passing the brass spyglass into Ibrahim's right hand, the copper sky and the ships offshore. decisions.issues: All hard checks pass. Nagoji wears the commander sheet with sleeves down and a flush gold ear stud with nothing hanging. His chin is clean-shaven and he is barefoot on the mat. Passes the hard checks: commander sheet, boots, sleeves down, no brand showing, talwar at the hip, thick moustache, shaven chin with only faint shading, four clusters of light with no masts, no text, and sound hands. Acceptable. The Goa ghost has the vaulted stone wall, the brazier and the table with iron tools. There are no ropes, no noose and no figures. Ear studs are flush on the lobe. Sleeves are down. FAIL on the brand: the arm planted on the rock is his RIGHT arm. That hand is palm down, thumb on the viewer's right, and is the near arm on the screen-left side of his body. Its sleeve is rolled up, and the scar mark is on the back (outer) side of the right forearm. The bible requires the edge of the brand on the INNER LEFT forearm only, with the right sleeve down. decisions.correction: Frame this as a tight insert, not a full figure. The camera is low and close at his LEFT side, slightly in front. His LEFT hand and forearm fill most of the panel. The left hand is planted flat on the rough, lichen-flecked bluff rock just behind and beside his left hip, fingers spread and pointing backward, away from the camera, as if he leans back a little. The palm is pressed hard into the stone. The knuckles and the uneven, ridged fingernails are sharp in the foreground. Because the fingers point backward, the pale INNER (palm-side) surface of the left forearm faces the camera. The cream LEFT sleeve is eased back only a little past the wrist. A hand's width above the wrist, half hidden at the cuff's edge, just the edge of an old pale puckered patch of raised scar ridges shows. It has no letters, no numerals and no cross. Put no mark on the back of the hand, on the outer forearm or on the right arm. His right arm is not shown, or stays fully sleeved. At one edge show only a sliver of the cream trouser knee and the red sash. The light is cool night moonlight, with the four small clusters of ship lights soft and out of focus beyond the rock edge. Keep the upper third as dark open sky or shadowed rock for two speech balloons. No face is needed in this panel.

decisions.issues: Acceptable. Faint haze over the second of four clusters of lights. Nagoji's head is turned toward it with brows drawn and eyes narrowed. v02 is acceptable and fixes v01. It is an extreme wide shot with the tiny seated figure at the bluff edge in the left third. The long dark coast curves away with only one faint lamp.
